newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen little moved as JGBs head higher.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen little moved as JGBs head higher.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures remained unimpressed by gains in Japanese government bond (JGB) futures on Wednesday and continued to consolidate on the higher end of their recent ranges.

Dealers said trading interest was hampered by caution ahead of Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's two-part Humphrey-Hawkins testimony to the U.S. Senate Banking Committee on Wednesday and Thursday.
JGB futures were well bid, partly on the back of gains in Tokyo where better-than-expected sales of newly auctioned 10-year JGBs boosted sentiment for the bond futures.

"The undertone was quite firm on the JGBs. There was a good offer at 126.29/30 but nothing behind it so after breaking through there, it went all the way up on very light volume," said a trader with an Asian futures house.
"It was very technical trade. There was no news behind it," he said, adding that players were also beginning to roll over their positions to the June contract.
March JGBs settled at 126.45 against their previous 126.17.

Turnover for December Euroyen, already the benchmark contract on TIFFE, outpaced September for the first time on SIMEX. The contract was quoted at 99.25 at 1145 GMT against its IMM close at 99.23 with 7,455 lots traded.
Eurodollar futures closed unmoved with the September contract at 94.22 against its IMM settlement at 94.22.
